extracted.name: Melt-in-Your-Mouth Beef Cacciatore
extracted.description: Veal cacciatore made with beef simmered in a tomato-based broth with onion and mushrooms in this melt-in-your-mouth slow cooker beef cacciatore recipe.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 onions, cut into wedges and sliced
1 cup dry red wine (such as Cabernet or Merlot)
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add roast and garlic; season roast with salt and pepper. Cook roast until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer roast and garlic to a slow cooker; add onions, crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, water, green bell pepper, mushrooms, red wine, sugar, fennel seed, Italian seasoning, and thyme.
